plugin.name: Parts from lines
plugin.description: Walls, straight stairs and spiral stairs from drawn lines: draw a line or chain (or select a face for its outline), choose the part and its sizes – it stays editable while it is selected.

panel.selectLine: Select one line, a chain of lines or one face first.

hint.wall: The wall follows the line – corners meet in a mitre. A closed chain or a face makes a room.
hint.stairs: The stair climbs from the line’s start to its end; the line is its middle.
hint.spiral: The line’s start is the middle, its length the radius; the stair starts towards its end.
